title: Make committed-export regression fixtures portable to Windows
body:
On native Windows, all nine `test_research_export.py` tests fail in setup because the common fixture filename contains a newline and `*`. Using a materializable filename then exposes an LF-versus-CRLF console-receipt failure. This repairs the fixtures so the exporter’s existing checks actually execute on Windows, while retaining the unusual Git pathname coverage.

The extraction/replay fixture uses a portable Unicode name. A new test constructs the original `inputs/a\n雪[*].bin` through real Git blobs, NUL-delimited trees and a commit, then checks literal inventory, repeatable exports, the offline receipt and exact binary payload without checking the name out. The symlink rejection uses real committed mode `120000` without requiring OS symlink privileges. Only the console receipt uses universal-newline text decoding; artifact bytes and extracted CRLF payloads remain exact.

Only the test module and its replay documentation change. Production exporter code, immutable inputs and the selected frontier are unchanged.

### Evidence

| Environment | Normal Python | Optimized Python |
|---|---:|---:|
| Windows 11, CPython 3.12.0, Git 2.47.1.windows.1 | 18 pass, 2 existing skips | 18 pass, 2 existing skips |
| Ubuntu under WSL2, CPython 3.12.3, Git 2.43.0 | 20 pass | 20 pass |

The repaired ten-test module has **no skips**. The two Windows skips remain in the separate POSIX-colon fixture tests. Existing corruption, mode, missing/duplicate member, link, overwrite, dirty-worktree and late-Git-failure controls remain active.

```sh
python -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_export*.py' -v
python -O -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_export*.py' -v
git diff --check
```

Both changed files match their committed bytes at `20188e79a19f236eaea5bb67e5fe50411ea76727`. This is local suite verification; hosted CI and a mathematical cold replay are not claimed. The suggested selected-baseline command stopped at an omitted source in this sparse checkout; no selected-construction verification is inferred.

### Selection, overlap and attribution

Task `portable-replay`, priority revision 7, chooser seed `78c5bb9d763460ad101abdb809786566`, refined to this reproducible environment failure after reading the handoffs. Started from and refreshed canonical main `f626db5c3a3d781d8f7695038776c621651f75e1`; relevant guidance and files did not change. The submission refresh covered 355 open PRs and 3,486 Discussion records with complete remote pagination; the earlier historical search covered 3,852 closed PRs. Local package-note coverage is sparse, and unsearched diffs/unpublished work remain outside this overlap check.

[Canonical Discussion #4578](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4578) records the claim and result. Retains Tekalign’s #3138 exporter/tests and roger-sato’s #3629/#3641 boundary regressions; the Git-mode symlink fixture follows the existing publication-byte tests.

Open next question: replace the two POSIX-colon worktree fixtures with object-tree fixtures while retaining their CLI rejection and exact-byte checks. Arbitrary-name extraction support is outside this repair.

Prepared for Mihir Srivastava with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
